nvitk.measure.voxel¶

Voxel-based overlap metrics (dice, jaccard, precision, …).

All primitives accept Image or raw arrays. Unlike the BioImaging legacy implementation, the dispatching voxel_metrics function has a single unambiguous signature (it no longer silently interprets a dict as a callable registry).

Counts are computed on the active backend; a single host hop is used to produce the final Python int for each confusion cell.

Functions¶

confusion_counts(→ dict[str, int])

Return {'TP','TN','FP','FN'} counts from two binary masks.

dice(→ float)

Dice overlap 2·TP / (2·TP + FP + FN) in [0, 1] (0.0 when both masks are empty).

jaccard(→ float)

Jaccard / IoU TP / (TP + FP + FN) in [0, 1].

precision(→ float)

Fraction of predicted-positive voxels that are correct TP / (TP + FP).

recall(→ float)

Fraction of true-positive voxels that were recovered TP / (TP + FN) (sensitivity).

fpr(→ float)

False-positive rate FP / (FP + TN).

fnr(→ float)

False-negative rate FN / (FN + TP).

volume_similarity(→ float)

Relative volume difference |n_pred − n_true| / n_true (0 = identical volumes).

voxel_metrics(→ dict[str, float])

Compute a named subset of voxel-based metrics.
